dataset.population: Three invented observations; no external population inference.
dataset.window: Three explicitly listed observation events; all rows included.
dataset.sampling: Hand-authored numerical controls; not a probability sample.
dataset.basis: Synthetic fixture to demonstrate computation, not empirical evidence.

Aligned.text: Each actual and its interval refer to the same row event and unit.
Aligned.basis: Synthetic row IDs and hand calculation.

Central.text: Bounds are evaluated as an authored central 50 percent interval with alpha 1/2.
Central.basis: Synthetic score interpretation only; no fitted probability distribution.

Separate.text: These examples did not fit or tune a predictive model.
Separate.basis: There is no fitted model in this synthetic control.

Weights.text: Weights express relative descriptive mass; zero weights exclude mass without deleting rows.
Weights.basis: Authored synthetic weights; not sampling independence.

Independent.text: The four Bernoulli trials are independent in the conditional mathematical model.
Independent.basis: Explicit synthetic assumption, not an observed fact.

Common.text: All four modeled trials share probability 1/2.

Binary.text: Each modeled trial has exactly success or failure.
